description: This source file defines the OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL enum which provides functionality to parse, validate, decode, and encode JSON Lines (JSONL) messages related to a UI communication protocol, specifically for version 0.8 of the protocol.

classes.name: ParsedItem
classes.description: A struct representing a parsed line of JSONL containing the line number and the decoded message.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSONL string into an array of ParsedItem structs, decoding each line as an AnyCodable object.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates a list of ParsedItems against the expected allowed message types for version 0.8, ensuring only specific message types are present.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Parses and validates JSONL text to produce an array of decoded messages (AnyCodable) if the format and version are correct.

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes an array of AnyCodable messages into a JSON array string.
